headline: Executive order titled "Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence" appears to address advanced artificial intelligence, but no details were provided.
what_it_does: This executive order was signed by President Donald Trump on September 29, 2026. Its title suggests it deals with very advanced artificial intelligence, sometimes called "superintelligence." No summary or text was provided, so its specific rules, programs, or directions to federal agencies cannot be described here.
when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the source material. Executive orders often take effect when signed, which here would be September 29, 2026.
